name: rms-console-sites
description: The client of the DevOps, Configuration and documentation consoles: the refreshing regions, the followed logs, the sortable tables and the dismissable alerts.

scripts.verify: webpack --config webpack.config.js --json --no-color | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);if(r.errors.length){console.error(r.errors.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}console.log('webpack: '+r.assets.length+' asset(s), no source maps');});"
